title: Partner Solutions Architect
options: Remote, Any, United States, AMER [remote]
description:
# About Us
[under: About Us] It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
[under: About the Role] We're looking for a Partner Solutions Architect to own the global technical relationship with Snowflake and Databricks.
[under: About the Role] This is a global role scoped to those two partners.
[under: About the Role] For each, you will own the technical alliance plan worldwide, the joint technical narrative, and our joint integration and roadmap priorities with each partner to drive cosell revenue.
[under: About the Role] Your closest counterparts are the global alliance managers for Snowflake and Databricks, the regional partner sales managers who run the Snowflake and Databricks motions in AMER, EMEA and APJ, the geo partner solutions architects, and product managers across both product lines.
[under: About the Role] You will report to the global head of partner solutions architecture.
[under: About the Role] This is a full-time position, which can be either remote (US) or hybrid depending on location.
[under: About the Role] Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.
[under: What You’ll Do] - Own the global technical alliance plans for Snowflake and Databricks. Build each plan with the partner's alliance and product leadership, agree it with our own, and drive it through both field organizations.
[under: What You’ll Do] - Partner with the regional Partner Solutions Architects and Partnerships organization so global alliance strategy turns into regional execution, and so they can run the motion without you in the room.
> [under: Perks and Benefits] - Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
> [under: Perks and Benefits] *May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information
> [under: Perks and Benefits] Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.
> [under: Perks and Benefits] Read about us in Forbes.
> [under: Perks and Benefits] Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.
